mapper.sql: SELECT d.GROUP_ID, d.GROUP_TITLE, d.MEMBER_ID, d.MEMBER_NAME, d.PAY_MONTH, d.DUE_DATE, d.ELAPSED_DAYS FROM ( SELECT g.GROUP_ID, g.TITLE AS GROUP_TITLE, gm.MEMBER_ID, mb.NAME AS MEMBER_NAME, TO_CHAR(mo.YM, 'YYYYMM') AS PAY_MONTH, mo.YM + (g.PAY_DAY - 1) AS DUE_DATE, TRUNC(#{today}) - (mo.YM + (g.PAY_DAY - 1)) AS ELAPSED_DAYS, g.STARTED_AT, gm.JOINED_AT, g.MONTHS FROM GYE_GROUP g JOIN GYE_MEMBER gm ON gm.GROUP_ID = g.GROUP_ID AND gm.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' JOIN MEMBER mb ON mb.MEMBER_ID = gm.MEMBER_ID JOIN (SELECT ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(#{today}, 'MM'), 1 - LEVEL) AS YM FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 37) mo ON mo.YM >= TRUNC(g.STARTED_AT, 'MM') WHERE g.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND g.STARTED_AT IS NOT NULL ) d WHERE d.DUE_DATE >= TRUNC(d.STARTED_AT) -- ① AND d.DUE_DATE >= TRUNC(d.JOINED_AT) -- ② AND d.DUE_DATE < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(d.STARTED_AT), d.MONTHS) -- ③ AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PAYMENT_PROOF p WHERE p.GROUP_ID = d.GROUP_ID AND p.MEMBER_ID = d.MEMBER_ID AND p.PAY_MONTH = d.PAY_MONTH AND p.STATUS = 'CONFIRMED')
mapper.select: SELECT u.* FROM () u WHERE u.ELAPSED_DAYS >= #{minDays} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM OVERDUE_CASE o WHERE o.GROUP_ID = u.GROUP_ID AND o.MEMBER_ID = u.MEMBER_ID AND o.PAY_MONTH = u.PAY_MONTH) ORDER BY u.GROUP_ID, u.MEMBER_ID, u.PAY_MONTH
SELECT u.* FROM () u WHERE u.ELAPSED_DAYS = #{days} ORDER BY u.GROUP_ID, u.MEMBER_ID
